title: fix(github): install telecom ci linux build deps
summary: Telecom CI installs the Linux headers needed by compile jobs.
details: Provide pkg-config, fontconfig and freetype dependencies through its managed workflow instead of consumer-specific patches.
Original GitHub merge e7ca7bc1cd60471d01b60cf0a79a7c8cf7cf1c15 is distinct from rewritten main-history delivery ae04582964e695194bcfe341fe0b3f640d769d8b; the merge date is the verified GitHub date.
